exposure: Intrauterine transfusion (IUT) for hemolytic disease of the fetus and newborn (HDFN)
Middle cerebral artery peak systolic velocity (MCA-PSV)
outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
Readmission for red blood cell transfusion
cohort: The study included 67 pregnancies, resulting in 68 live-born infants, who received intrauterine transfusion for hemolytic disease of the fetus and newborn (HDFN).
finding: HDFN is an important cause of fetal anemia associated with significant neonatal morbidity, and MCA-PSV and MoM may be predictive of neonatal phototherapy requirements.
mod_finding: One neonatal death occurred following spontaneous vaginal delivery at 23 + 4 weeks gestation, but no general findings related to mode of birth were reported.
